canonicalImmutability.reason: Runtime classification is a derived layer and must not mutate the closed lossless canonical specification.

DIRECT_PRINT_SYMBOL.definition: Source symbol record has one explicit unique print key and a deterministic Braille sequence.

SEMANTIC_SYMBOL.definition: Source symbol record has semantic identity but no direct print key; selection requires an owning rule, context, state, or structural layer.

definitions.DIRECT_MAPPING: Already-resolved input or semantic identity deterministically emits Braille without state, contextual selection, structural ownership, or unresolved dependency.
definitions.CONTEXTUAL: Selection, emission, or interpretation depends on surrounding text, semantic role, ambiguity, lexical context, spacing, or boundary conditions.
definitions.STATEFUL: Rule reads, enters, continues, exits, or otherwise depends on explicit translation state.
definitions.STRUCTURAL: Rule belongs to layout, document structure, or serialization structure rather than ordinary scalar mapping.
definitions.DELEGATED: Execution is owned by another explicit profile, subsystem, resolver, or later processing layer.
definitions.DEFERRED: Normative or implementation dependency is intentionally unresolved and the rule must not be executed yet.
definitions.ARCHITECTURAL_ONLY: Record captures non-executable architectural classification or inference rather than a normative translation operation.

classificationPrecedencePolicy.meaning: When a rule satisfies more than one classification characteristic, the highest applicable disposition in this ordered list owns the primary runtime classification.
